subject: Terra Health: vendor security follow-up & certification plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@terrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Terra Health — post-call recap & suggested next steps

Hi Lena,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking us through Terra Health's priorities. Quick recap from my side so we're aligned and can move the security intake forward: 

- Scope: initial deployment will be a customer-facing analytics feature that processes de-identified patient datasets. Terra Health expects HIPAA safeguards for the upstream data pipeline and wants SOC 2 Type II for vendor controls.
- Immediate asks: a completed vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a document you use internally), a list of encryption/KMS requirements, and confirmation if ISO 27001 is a strategic objective for 2027.
- Risk/constraints: Terraform-managed VPC, required quarterly penetration test reports, and a potential FedRAMP conversation depending on federal pilot participation later next year.

I've attached a short scope proposal (redwood-initial-scope-proposal-v1.pdf) with our recommended SOC boundary and a blank vendor questionnaire template for your security team to populate (vendor_security_questionnaire_terra.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Your team returns the completed questionnaire by end of day Nov 25 (gives us time to triage).
2) We schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with Karthik and your infra lead the week of Nov 29 to confirm network controls and KMS patterns.
3) If ISO is on the roadmap, we can add a short session to map gaps (estimated 2–3 weeks of discovery).

Would you like me to book the deep-dive or should Monica coordinate through your security alias?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: redwood-initial-scope-proposal-v1.pdf (4 pages), vendor_security_questionnaire_terra.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@terrahealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Terra Health Security Team <security@terrahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Terra Health — post-call recap & suggested next steps

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We'll populate the vendor questionnaire. I can commit to returning it by Nov 25 but will likely have our infra lead add technical notes.
- For KMS: we require HSM-backed keys and a key-rotation policy; I'll flag the sections in the questionnaire.
- ISO 27001: strategic yes, but target date is H2 2027; for now SOC 2 scope is higher priority.
- FedRAMP: we are exploring a pilot with a federal partner in Q2 2027, so we'll need to understand what Redwood's path to FedRAMP would look like (options/limitations).

Quick ask: can Redwood provide your standard penetration-testing cadence and a redacted report sample we can share with our procurement? Also send any SOC 2 control mappings you recommend for an analytics product (data ingestion, processing, ML inference).

If Monica can coordinate calendar options for the Nov 29 week that works — prefer afternoons EST.

Lena Ortiz
VP, Partner Integrations | Terra Health
lena.ortiz@terrahealth.com

Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (we'll return this with notes)

Hi Lena — thanks, we'll handle the schedule.

Action items from Redwood side (internal note included for Rishi/Karthik):
- I will send two calendar options for the technical deep-dive (Nov 29 afternoon slots EST) and include Karthik + our infra lead (Diego from infra).

  * Our SOC 2 control mapping for data ingestion and model inference
  * Pen-test cadence and an anonymized sample report (we can redact customer identifiers)
  * Overview of our KMS/HSM integrations and recommended configuration for Terra's Terraform-managed VPC

Lena — attaching a procurement-ready one-pager on our security posture (redwood-initial-scope-proposal-v1.pdf) and I'll drop the anonymized pen-test summary once Karthik confirms.

Lena / team — quick technical notes ahead of the deep-dive: 

- SOC 2 mapping: I'll share a short control matrix that maps Redwood controls to common SOC trust services categories, with emphasis on Access Control, Change Management, and Encryption. Expect that as a link in a follow-up email.
- Pen-test cadence: annual third-party test plus quarterly internal scans; I will compile an anonymized executive summary (2 pages).
- KMS: we support BYOK with HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS with external key manager) and integration options for Terraform workflows — bring any constraints to the call so we can walk through examples.

I'll prepare those artifacts by EOD Nov 24 so you have them before filling the questionnaire. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Regards,
